modules.module_title: Communicate with others in an efficient manner

pcs.pc_description: interact with people at workplace in a polite and professional manner
listen actively to the issues or requirements and respond timely and appropriately
trust, support and respect people at workplace
offer friendly, courteous and hospitable service to others
avoid interrupting others while they talk
pass on appropriate information to others and in a time bound manner
seek and provide feedback to others on a regular basis
maintain clarity, honesty and transparency while communicating with others
respect the personal and professional space of people at workplace
maintain appropriate body language while communicating with others
respect people across all, age groups, genders, religions, and caste
empathize with the people with disability and elderly
offer support or help to a person with a disability and eldery, if asked
use inclusive language that is sensitive to people towards all gender, disability and age
ensure to adhere to the guidelines laid in Sexual Harassment of Women at Workplace (Prevention, Prohibition and Redressal) Act
report any violation of prevention of sexual harassment (POSH) rules immediately to the POSH committee
